title: Rethink microcopy and progressive disclosure for compound icon buttons
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Compound icon buttons (multi-action compact surfaces and icon clusters) are causing inconsistent affordance across themes and screen sizes. Users and engineers report: unclear click targets for secondary icons, truncated tooltips in narrow layouts, and copy that assumes desktop-only gestures. This ticket proposes a combined design + content strategy: 1) introduce progressive disclosure behavior for compound buttons so the primary action is always clear while secondary actions are discoverable; 2) standardize microcopy and tooltip grammar, localize patterns, and ensure copy works for screen readers; 3) implement theme-aware layout rules so label truncation and disclosure affordances don't break in high-contrast or compact density modes. Goals: reduce accidental clicks, improve discoverability for secondary actions, and eliminate regressions across themes and density tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Primary action remains visually dominant across all themes and densities (compact, default, comfortable)
When collapsed, compound buttons show a single primary affordance with an explicit chevron or ellipsis indicator for extras
Tooltips and microcopy follow the new style guide: present-tense verb + object (eg. 'Save draft', 'Open menu') and fit within 2 lines at 320px width
All microcopy is localized and verified for two example languages (es, de) without truncation in UI examples
Screen reader behavior: when compound button is collapsed, SR reads primary action and 'more actions' control with role=\"button\" and aria-expanded state
No visual regressions in high-contrast themes; contrast ratios meet AA for text and 3:1 for icon targets where applicable
Engineering integration points documented (props: collapsed, disclosurePlacement, a11yLabel, density) and unit tests added for rendering states
engineering_notes: Suggested API: <CompoundButton primaryLabel="Save" secondaryActions=[{icon, label}] collapsedBreakpoint=320 disclosureIcon="chevron" />
Performance: prefer CSS transforms for reveal animation to avoid layout thrashing; keep animation optional via prefers-reduced-motion
Theming: consult token set 'button.surface-foreground' and 'button.icon-gap' for spacing adjustments; add fallback tokens for legacy themes
Accessibility: ensure a single tabbable element in collapsed state; expanded menu should trap focus and expose role=menu with menuitem roles
qa_checklist: Verify collapsed -> expanded transition at breakpoints (320px, 420px, 768px)
Check tooltip wrapping in es/de/localized builds at small widths
Run automated contrast tests for primary and disclosure icons in all themes
Screen reader walkthroughs: VoiceOver and NVDA for both collapsed and expanded states
Regression sweep against existing icon-only and split-button stories in the component explorer
